description: Sync the BambooHR employee directory and time off. Each employee is one document linked to their manager, and each time-off request or who's-out entry is linked to its employee.
opening: Sync the BambooHR employee directory and time off. Each employee is one document with their job title, manager, department, division, location, work email, work phone and status, linked to their manager. Each time-off request and each who's-out entry is one document, linked to the employee it belongs to.

BambooHR permissions are not imported, so every synced employee and absence is visible to everyone who can query the collection unless you set an access rule. HR data is often sensitive. Departed employees and cancelled absences stay in HydraDB. Compensation, employee files and custom fields are not synced.

connect.auth: BambooHR uses an API key together with your company's subdomain.

credentials.name: subdomain
credentials.text: Your company's subdomain from its BambooHR address, for example `acme` for `acme.bamboohr.com`.

steps.title: Get an API key
steps.text: Get a BambooHR API key. HydraDB syncs the employee directory and time off that this key can read.

steps.title: Create the connector
steps.text: Paste the key as `auth_token` and your company's subdomain as `subdomain`.

steps.title: Configure the connector
steps.text: HydraDB lists one account-wide resource, All data. Select it to sync everything the key can read as one unit.

connect.account: One connector reads one BambooHR company, the one named by `subdomain`.

sync.first_sync: Reads the whole employee directory the key can see. Time-off requests updated within the window set by `lookback_days`, 30 days by default, whatever the dates of the leave. Who's-out entries for the dates in that window.
sync.changes: Each sync reads the whole directory again, time-off requests updated since the last sync, and who's-out entries for the dates the sync covers. Future absences are not guaranteed to appear as who's-out entries.
sync.edits: A changed employee or time-off request replaces its document. A who's-out entry is read again only while its dates fall in the window a sync covers.
sync.deletes: Not removed. A departed employee or a cancelled absence stays in HydraDB.

shared_attributes.name: connector_id
shared_attributes.text: Limits a query to this connector's documents. Not searchable.

documents.name: Employees
documents.one_document: One employee in the directory the API key can read.
documents.title: The employee's display name. Otherwise the first and last name.
documents.text: The name, then `Job Title`, `Reports To`, `Department`, `Division`, `Location`, `Email`, `Phone` and `Status` lines. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: None. The directory has no change time, so ranking by date cannot order employees.

attributes.name: display_name
attributes.text: The directory display name. Forms the title and the name in the text.

attributes.name: first_name, last_name
attributes.text: The employee's first and last name. Used for the title and the name in the text only when there is no display name.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.text: The job title, in the `Job Title` line.

attributes.name: reports_to
attributes.text: The manager's name from the employee's latest job information, in the `Reports To` line. When the name matches an employee in the directory, links the employee to that manager. Two people with the same name can cause a wrong link or no link.

attributes.name: department, division, location
attributes.text: Where the employee sits in the organisation, in the `Department`, `Division` and `Location` lines.

attributes.name: work_email, work_phone
attributes.text: The work email and work phone, in the `Email` and `Phone` lines.

attributes.name: status
attributes.text: The employment status, in the `Status` line.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.bamboohr_employee_id
attributes.text: The BambooHR employee id. Finds one employee. Not searchable.

documents.name: Time-off entries
documents.one_document: One time-off request, or one who's-out calendar entry.
documents.title: The employee's name.
documents.text: The employee's name, then `Type`, `Status`, `Start` and `End` lines. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: The first day of the absence.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.text: Links the absence to the employee it belongs to. Not searchable.

attributes.name: type
attributes.text: The kind of time off, such as Vacation or Sick, in the `Type` line.

attributes.name: status
attributes.text: The approval status, in the `Status` line.

attributes.name: start
attributes.text: The first day of the absence, in the `Start` line. It is the result date.

attributes.name: end
attributes.text: The last day of the absence, in the `End` line.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.bamboohr_time_off_id
attributes.text: The BambooHR time-off id. Finds one request or entry. Not searchable.

attributes.name: created
attributes.text: When a time-off request was created. Who's-out entries have none.

example_searches: Who works in the Finance department?
What is Sam's work email and job title?

connections: An employee to their manager, when the manager's name matches an employee in the directory.
A time-off request or who's-out entry to its employee.
graph.people: Employees and their managers, through the manager link. Departments, divisions and locations are not attached as groups. They are in the text only.
graph.from_text: Each employee's directory lines and each absence's type and status.

not_synced: Compensation, custom reports, photos, employee files and custom fields.
Job history other than the latest manager.
Time-off amounts, employee notes, per-day breakdowns and the actions allowed on a request.
A guaranteed calendar of future absences.
Deletions: departed employees and cancelled absences stay in HydraDB.
